Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes, reporting neck
and low back pain with associated stiffness and muscle tightness. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the
reported symptoms for a collision of this type. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted
cervical and lumbar range of motion, which support a soft tissue strain of the neck and back. Neurological screening,
including reflexes, sensation, and strength in both upper and lower extremities, was within normal limits. No prior
injury or treatment to these body regions is known to this provider. Care consisetd of 23 visits combining manual
therapy, guided home exercise, and supervised stretching. Progress was steady, and visit frequency was reduced
gradually as pain and mobility improved. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no duplicate or
repeated charges. The patient is now near baseline fucntion with occasional discomfort during prolonged sitting.
Continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up were recommended.
